programme.desc: Sangam reveals the truth about her marriage and asks Krishna for a divorce. Heartbroken by her decision, Krishna agrees to meet a lawyer as she seeks legal help.

programme.title: तू जूलियट जट्ट दी
programme.sub-title: Fateh discovers the secret past marriage between Heer and Nawab. Soon after, Heer and Fateh are left stunned to learn that Brar Industries sponsors Nawab and owns Kukreja Cookers
programme.desc: हीर की मुलाकात एक नवाब से होने पर एक प्रेम प्रसंग शुरू होता है। उनकी यात्रा चुनौतियों से भर जाती है, जो छल और भावनात्मक उथल-पुथल से गुंथी प्रेम कहानी को उजागर करती है।.

credits.actor: Jasmeet Kaur (Heer Sandhu),Syed Raza Ahmed (Nawab Brar),Sangita Ghosh (Gulaab Brar),Digvijay Purohit (Dilip Brar),Alisha Parveen Khan (Tina),Chetna Singh (Anmol Brar),Anmol Gupta (Jimmy Brar),Pardeep Singh Toor (Sunny Brar)

programme.title: तू जूलियट जट्ट दी
programme.sub-title: Nawab confronts Ajit for trapping Heer in her room, but the building starts collapsing. Courageously, Heer streams live to disclose her location
programme.desc: हीर की मुलाकात एक नवाब से होने पर एक प्रेम प्रसंग शुरू होता है। उनकी यात्रा चुनौतियों से भर जाती है, जो छल और भावनात्मक उथल-पुथल से गुंथी प्रेम कहानी को उजागर करती है।.

programme.title: मन्नत हर ख़ुशी पाने की
programme.sub-title: Samragi swaps Manyata's blood sample, shocking Vikrant and Mannat with a positive result. When Vikrant is arrested, Mannat vows to prove his innocence
programme.desc: एक प्रतिभाशाली युवा शेफ मन्नत, बड़े सपने देखती है लेकिन उसकी नियोक्ता ऐश्वर्या के रूप में उसके सामने बड़ी बाधा आती है। दोनों अंजान है, कि ऐश्वर्या मन्नत की माँ भी है जिसने उसे जन्म के समय छोड़ा था।.

credits.actor: Ayesha Singh,Adnan Khan,Mamta Verma,Mona Vasu,Sharain Khanduja,Hasan Zaidi,Roopa Divetia,Pradeep Shukla

programme.title: डॉक्टर आरंभी
programme.sub-title: Dimple learns that Sunil has agreed to celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi at the Tandon house. Later, Vishwas gets a warning
programme.desc: विवाह के बंधन में बंधी, पूर्व एआईपीएमटी टॉपर आरंभी एक छिपे हुए सपने को संजोए रखती है, अपने जीवन के दूसरे अध्याय को शुरू करने के लिए एक चिंगारी का इंतजार करती है।.

credits.actor: Aishwarya Khare,Aditya Bipin Redij,Arjit Taneja (Dhruv Chawla),Anjum Fakih (Dr. Avantika Mehta),Neena Cheema (Kunika Chawla),Bhuvnesh Shetty (Balbir Chaudhary)

programme.title: सहर होने को है
programme.sub-title: Mahid manages to manipulate Husna and helps Seher escape from the latter's room. Later, Seher confesses her true feelings to Mahid
programme.desc: सहर बड़े सपने देखने वाली एक युवा महिला है, और उसकी मां कौसर अपनी बेटी के रास्ते में आने वाली सामाजिक बाधाओं को दूर करने के लिए दृढ़ संकल्पित है।.

credits.actor: Parth Samthaan (Mahid),Rishita Kothari (Seher),Mahhi Vij (Kausar),Vaquar Shaikh,Apurva Agnihotri,Deepak Qazir

programme.title: बरेली की बच्चन
programme.desc: Sangam is compelled to provide her Aadhar card for the lawyer to move forward with her divorce. Meanwhile, Shankar gets manipulated by Krishna.

programme.title: जूही मुई
programme.sub-title: The judge agrees with Juhi after she presents a compelling legal argument in court. Elsewhere, Sanyam receives Laddoo from Pankhuri, who promises to remain by her side through every trial
programme.desc: तेज़ दिमाग वाली जूही ऑटिस्टिक है और उसमें असाधारण प्रतिभा है, लेकिन दुनिया अक्सर उसका मज़ाक उड़ाती है। जब कोई संकट आता है, तो वह वकील का रूप धारण करती है और उसका भाई उसे सही राह दिखाता है।.

programme.title: महादेव एण्ड संस
programme.sub-title: Mahadev organises grand remarriage celebrations for both Narmada-Ketan and Dheeraj-Rajji. While Dheeraj prepares to propose to Rajji, she encounters unexpected trouble while traveling on the road
programme.desc: महादेव का सिद्धांतवादी दृष्टिकोण अपने परिवार को मजबूत हाथों से मार्गदर्शन करने का अनजाने में विद्रोह के बीज बोता है, जो पीढ़ीगत असंतोष के युग की शुरुआत करता है।.

programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In \"Naked and Afraid,\" complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E5 — The One With Joey's New Girlfriend Chandler falls for Joey's new date, Ross discovers that the woman that he thinks he's dating actually thinks he's the babysitter, Rachel's new college boyfriend steals, and Phoebe tries to re-catch a cold to improve her singing voice.
programme.title: Friends

programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E7 — The One Where Chandler Crosses the Line Chandler finally confesses to his feelings for Kathy just after she splits up with Joey, Ross rediscovers his hopeless musical skills on the keyboard which Phoebe alone appreciates, and Chandler buys new furniture for the apartment since the robbery left them with just the canoe, chick and duck.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E8 — The One With Chandler in a Box The friends have a Thanksgiving meal together. Monica is reminded of Richard when she tries to kiss his son. Joey frees Chandler from the box that he's being kept in to stop Kathy leaving him.
programme.title: Friends

Monica upsets Phoebe by stopping the catering business before it has started after she gets the head chef job at a restaurant where the staff all hate her. Rachel's boss is killed in a car accident before she can make Rachel a junior buyer.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E10 — The One With the Girl From Poughkeepsie Ross struggles to maintain a long-distance relationship, Chandler's well-intended attempts to get Rachel a date seem to miss the mark, and Monica's plan to assert some authority at her new restaurant goes away.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E11 — The One With Phoebe's Uterus Phoebe's half-brother makes an astounding announcement and a thought-provoking request, while Joey finds himself in a class struggle.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E12 — The One With the Embryos Phoebe undergoes an embryo implant procedure to become a surrogate mother for her brother and his wife, and Monica and Rachel wager their flat in a trivia game against Chandler and Joey.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S4 E13 — The One With Rachel's Crush Rachel schemes to get a handsome client to ask her on a date, while Chandler's jealousy causes problems with his girlfriend. Elsewhere, after losing a bet, Monica and Rachel must swap their apartment with Chandler and Joey's.

programme.desc: S3 E1 — The One With the Princess Leia Fantasy Monica is distraught after her breakup with Richard. Phoebe unsuccessfully tries to raise her spirits, but ultimately it's Mr Geller who comforts his daughter. Elsewhere, Chandler and Janice begin seeing each other again and Joey can't stand it. The two plan a day of fun to try to overcome Joey's aversions for Chandler's sake. Meanwhile, Rachel tells Phoebe and Monica about Ross's Princess Leia fantasy.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E2 — The One Where No One's Ready In a race against the clock, Ross tries to get the gang dressed and ready for a black-tie benefit at the museum.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E3 — The One With the Jam Monica decides the best way to get over Richard is to keep herself busy. She develops a 'jam plan', hoping the distraction of cooking will divert her attention. After making jars and jars of jam Monica decides she still wants to have a baby, so she begins searching for a sperm donor, and comes across Joey's file. Elsewhere, Phoebe is mistakenly stalked by a man who thinks she's Ursula, and Chandler receives dating advice.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E4 — The One With the Metaphorical Tunnel Ross panics when he sees his son with a Barbie doll, and Chandler's fear of commitment surfaces in his relationship with Janice.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E5 — The One with Frank Jr Phoebe's attempts to introduce her visiting half brother Frank Jr to the delights of city life leave him thinking that she works in a brothel. Meanwhile, Ross lists five famous women that he would like to date.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E6 — The One With the Flashback When Janice asks the gang if any of them have ever slept together, the friends flashback three years ago. Phoebe moves out of Monica's apartment, Chandler and Joey become roommates, Monica bumps into Rachel, and Ross learns that Carol is a lesbian.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E7 — The One With the Race Car Bed When Monica buys a new bed from the Mattress King, the wrong one is delivered. Meanwhile, Joey sees Janice kissing her husband, and Rachel's father clashes with Ross.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E8 — The One With the Giant Poking Device Chandler and Janice reach a turning point in their relationship, while Monica accidentally injures Ben and tries to hide it from Ross.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E9 — The One With the Football On Thanksgiving, the friends form teams and play American football. Ross and Monica relive their sibling rivalry by going head-to-head as opposing team captains. Rachel is upset that Ross didn't choose her for his team, and Joey tries to outwit his foe Chandler. Meanwhile, the turkey is left stewing while the losing team calls for a rematch.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E10 — The One Where Rachel Quits Rachel wonders if she'll ever get another job after she quits Central Perk, Joey's new job selling Christmas trees upsets Phoebe, and Ross accidentally breaks a little girl's leg.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E11 — The One Where Chandler Can't Remember Which Sister Ross is suspicious about Rachel's possible job offer from a good-looking stranger, while Chandler can't remember which of Joey's many attractive sisters he kissed at a party.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E12 — The One With All the Jealousy Ross becomes increasingly jealous of Rachel's sexy new colleague, Mark, and gets the wrong end of the stick when he spies on Rachel at her office. Meanwhile, Monica is enamoured with a sexy bus boy who writes love poems for her, and Joey gets himself into trouble by faking his CV in order to get a part in a Broadway musical.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E13 — The One Where Monica and Richard Are Just Friends Monica bumps into Richard in a video store, and they decide to work on their friendship, but the more time they spend together, the more sexual their relationship becomes. Meanwhile, Phoebe dates an athlete who unintentionally keeps exposing himself by wearing loose shorts, and Rachel agrees to read 'The Shining' if Joey will read 'Little Women'.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E14 — The One With Phoebe's Ex-Partner Phoebe is reunited with her former singing partner, Leslie, a failed television commercial jingle writer who wants to use Phoebe's signature song 'Smelly Cat' in an advertisement for cat litter. Meanwhile, Ross becomes jealous when Rachel agrees to go to a fashion lecture with Mark, a former colleague who has just left for a new job, and Chandler meets a beautiful woman, Ginger, who has a prosthetic leg.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E15 — The One Where Ross and Rachel Take a Break Rachel's job prevents her from celebrating her anniversary with Ross. Wanting more time to focus on her new job, she suggests the two take a break from their relationship. Convinced that Rachel has dumped him for one of her workmates, Ross hooks up with a woman from the copy shop that Joey and Chandler have been after.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E16 — The One With the Morning After Ross tries to prevent Rachel from learning his disturbing secret. Meanwhile, Monica, Phoebe, Chandler and Joey spend a night eavesdropping.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E17 — The One Without the Ski Trip Ross and Rachel have been fighting for the group's attention since the breakup. Rachel invites everyone except Ross to her family cabin in the mountains, but on the way to the cabin, they run out of petrol. Everyone wants to call Ross for help, but Rachel won't let them.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E18 — The One With the Hypnosis Tape Phoebe is upset when her 18-year-old half-brother, Frank Jr, wants to marry his attractive home economics teacher, who is more than 25 years older than him. Elsewhere, Monica receives a tip from an admirer worth a small fortune, and a hypnosis tape intended to assist Chandler give up smoking has a rather strange effect on him.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E19 — The One With the Tiny T-Shirt Rachel's former colleague Mark asks her out on a date. When Rachel invites Ross to her apartment, he thinks she wants to get back together, but she just wants to return his things. Later, as Rachel and Mark return from their date, Ross spies on them through the peephole of Joey and Chandler's door. Meanwhile, Monica dates a millionaire, and Joey is cast in a play and clashes with the female lead.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E20 — The One With the Dollhouse Monica inherits a beautiful dollhouse that is too elaborate to play with, so Phoebe makes her own, but it meets a sad end. Meanwhile, Joey thinks he's found his true love, and Rachel's boss dates Chandler, placing her in a dangerous situation.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E21 — The One With a Chick and a Duck When Monica's millionaire friend Pete buys a restaurant and asks Monica to be the head chef, she is faced with a difficult decision. Meanwhile, Ross makes a sacrifice for Rachel, and Joey buys Chandler an unusual pet.
programme.title: Friends

programme.desc: S3 E22 — The One With the Screamer When Rachel finds out that Ross is bringing a date to Joey's opening night, she finds one of her own. Ross tries to convince Rachel that hers is mentally unbalanced. Meanwhile, Joey's play gets terrible reviews, but his co-star provides some comfort.
programme.title: Friends

The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.
programme.title: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level

programme.desc: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking

programme.desc: When the transition is being made from silent films to `talkies', everyone has trouble adapting. Don and Lina have been cast repeatedly as a romantic couple, but when their latest film is remade into a musical, only Don has the voice for the new singing part. After a lot of practise with a diction coach, Lina still sounds terrible, and Kathy, a bright young aspiring actress, is hired to record over her voice.
programme.title: Singin' in the Rain

programme.desc: Danny Noonan, a teen down on his luck, works as a caddy at the snob-infested Bushwood Country Club to raise money for his college education. In an attempt to gain votes for a college scholarship reserved for caddies, Noonan volunteers to caddy for a prominent and influential club member. Meanwhile, Danny struggles to prepare for the high pressure Caddy Day golf tournament while absorbing New Age advice from wealthy golf guru Ty Webb.

While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Cardiff Dan Jones explores the history of Cardiff Castle over more than 2,000 years and reveals how it became transformed from a strategically important Roman and Norman stronghold to a lavish fairy-tale Victorian home.
programme.title: Secrets of Great British Castles

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.title: Raiders Of The Lost Pharaohs

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Double Cross When a camouflaged item intrigues everyone, the teams are forced to take desperate measures to win. Plus, Brandon and Lori make an unlikely alliance.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E7 — Bowling for Billions Auction anarchy! Brandon and Scott hope to strike it lucky as they compete for ten-pin bowling equipment. T Money throws cash at a unit containing an ATM.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Sin City Sucker Punch Scott, Brandon and Lori hope to strike it rich in Vegas, but Dustin and Desert Dan are betting big too. The factions compete for a geologist's bin.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S2 E9 — Now You See It Now You Don't All bets are off as the auction-goers battle for bargains in Las Vegas. Dustin continues to pose a threat to Brandon and Lori as mystery bins test their resolve.
programme.title: Storage Hunters

programme.desc: S12 E9 — Let's Give 'Em Something to Tonka About Dave counts on his competition being unwilling to buy a big locker they need to move. Ivy and Ivy Jr. find their day somewhat therapeutic. Mary finally finds a tiny treasure to take home. Rene stands his ground to protect his honour.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E10 — Fowl Play Mary finds clothes that don't fit her, which turns out to be a good thing. Kenny takes a chance at being an early bird, but winds up looking more like a dodo.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E11 — What Came First: The Chicken or the Auction? Overwhelmed by the sheer number of units up for auction, Mary and Ivy wager that each can better predict final locker prices than the other. Dave's locker resembles a chop shop. Rene and Tatiana score vintage sporting goods.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E3 — A Sale of Two Cities Emily brings her mother along, as Darrell wastes no time finding an advantage. Ivy and Ivy Jr clean up with their locker and Kenny gets some advice from a music legend, while Shana and Edwina settle for thrifting what's in front of them.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E12 — The Wind Beneath My Bids Strong winds batter Desert Hot Springs, and the buyers do their best to keep standing. Rene and Gunther dust off an old locker. Brandi and Jarrod's unit takes a turn and ends up lapping the competition. Kenny steps up his game.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S12 E13 — Not All That Glitters Is Gourd The Vegas ladies arrive in the city of Orange, California. Casey picks up a good unit and Darrell tries to make a sale to Emily, but ends up settling for a decent locker.
programme.title: Storage Wars

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Egypt's Elite Experts unravel the mysteries of Ancient Egypt's Elite. Where is the lost tomb of Imhotep? And who was Ancient Egypt's first female pharaoh?
programme.title: Egypt's Unexplained Files

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Crime and Punishment An exploration of crime and punishment in Ancient Egypt filled with homicidal royalty, rampant tomb raiding and acts of extreme punishment.
programme.title: Egypt's Unexplained Files

programme.desc: S1 E1 — We Are At War Retraces the beginning of the German invasion of Poland and the segregation of the Jews. Mussolini joins Hitler in his fight against the Allies, Winston Churchill is appointed British Prime Minister, and Germany invades France.
programme.title: Hell on Earth: WWII

programme.desc: S1 E2 — We Shall Go On Autumn to Winter 1940 – 1941 Spring to Summer 1941 Germany continues to build its empire in Europe.
programme.title: Hell on Earth: WWII

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Darkness Falls As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.
programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Operation Torch In Operation Torch, the first joint US-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced US troops - and their untested leader Eisenhower - face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.
programme.title: World War II With Tom Hanks

programme.desc: S1 E7 — Langenburg Utilising the original audio from a witness over 50 years ago, we seek to understand what was seen in one of Canada's most notorious UFO sightings. Our team of experts discover there's more than just damaged crops at stake when they hypothesize that it was visitors from the exoplanet Kepler-442 b that landed on a small farm in 1974.
programme.title: UFO: POV

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Tinley Park Lights With over 160 different sightings, residents of the Chicago suburb of Tinley Park have got used to seeing the unexplained. The phenomena of the 'Tinley Park Lights' have caused many to question what they know as natural occurrences. Using exoplanet TOI-700 d to posit a theory of what these visitors may be looking for and what they are seeing, experts wonder if the UFO doesn't have nefarious aims?
programme.title: UFO: POV

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: On a remote island, a wealthy entrepreneur creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1993-06-09

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1997-05-23

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: Dr Alan Grant reluctantly accompanies a rich couple who are searching for their teenage son who crashed on the second Jurassic Park island while paragliding. Unfortunately for the adventurers, there are many unfamiliar - and deadly - dinosaurs lurking in the jungle. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2001-07-16

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Jurassic Park is now called Jurassic World, a fully functional dinosaur park that sees 20,000 visitors a year, the realisation of owner John Hammond's dreams. The scientists may have gone too far in creating some sort of hybrid dinosaur, which escapes and terrorises the park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2015-06-11

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinosaurs, while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2018-06-07

programme.title: Jurassic World Rebirth
programme.desc: Skilled operatives travel to an island research facility to secure life-saving DNA from dinosaurs. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2025-07-02

Always one step behind him, the family learns a lot about each other in the process. (Comedy) - 1996

programme.desc: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

programme.title: The Maltese Falcon
programme.desc: In this noir classic, detective Sam Spade (Humphrey Bogart) gets more than he bargained for when he takes a case brought to him by a beautiful but secretive woman (Mary Astor). As soon as Miss Wonderly shows up, trouble follows as Sam's partner is murdered and Sam is accosted by a man (Peter Lorre) demanding he locate a valuable statuette. Sam, entangled in a dangerous web of crime and intrigue, soon realizes he must find the one thing they all seem to want: the bejeweled Maltese falcon. (Crime drama) - 1941

programme.title: The Last Samurai
programme.desc: Capt. Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) is an American military officer hired by the Emperor of Japan to train the country's first army in the art of modern warfare. As the government attempts to eradicate the ancient Samurai warrior class in preparation for more Westernized and trade-friendly policies, Algren finds himself unexpectedly affected by his encounters with the Samurai, which places him at the center of a struggle between two eras and two worlds. (Adventure, Drama, War, Action) - 2003

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light. (Historical drama) - 2017

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: After transferring to a Los Angeles high school, Sarah (Robin Tunney) finds that her telekinetic gift appeals to a group of three wannabe witches, who happen to be seeking a fourth member for their rituals. Bonnie (Neve Campbell), Rochelle (Rachel True) and Nancy (Fairuza Balk), like Sarah herself, all have troubled backgrounds, which combined with their nascent powers lead to dangerous consequences. When a minor spell causes a fellow student to lose her hair, the girls grow power-mad. (Horror) - 1996

programme.title: Men
programme.desc: Harper retreats to the countryside to be alone in the wake of a tragedy, but her unease at the town's leering and uncannily similar men grows into a fully fledged nightmare as her arrival awakens something primal in the forest. (Thriller, Horror) - 2022

programme.title: Blood Father
programme.desc: An ex-convict (Mel Gibson) and his estranged daughter (Erin Moriarty) go on the run from her drug-dealing boyfriend (Diego Luna) and his vicious cartel. (Action, Thriller) - 2016

programme.desc: With their headquarters destroyed and the world held hostage, members of Kingsman find new allies when they discover a spy organization in the United States known as Statesman. In an adventure that tests their strength and wits, the elite secret agents from both sides of the pond band together to battle a ruthless enemy and save the day, something that's becoming a bit of a habit for Eggsy. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2017

programme.title: The Mountain Between Us
programme.desc: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Romance) - 2017

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

programme.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
programme.desc: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

programme.title: Joker
programme.desc: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

programme.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
programme.desc: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Musical, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

programme.title: Life of Pi
programme.desc: After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive. (Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2012

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

programme.title: Body at Brighton Rock
programme.desc: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

programme.title: Companion
programme.desc: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Thriller, Science fiction, Horror, Dark comedy) - 2025

programme.desc: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

programme.title: Trance
programme.desc: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

programme.title: Destroy All Monsters!
programme.desc: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Science fiction) - 1968

programme.desc: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante
programme.desc: A monster dinosaur wrecks Tokyo some more and meets a monster plant created from his own cells. (Science fiction) - 1989

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
programme.desc: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Science fiction) - 1972

programme.title: The Snakes
programme.desc: A woman's violent fantasies spiral out of control when she joins a neighborhood watch group. (Drama) - 2021

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets
programme.desc: Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

programme.title: Camp Hell
programme.desc: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

programme.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
programme.desc: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Final Destination 5
programme.desc: During a bus ride with his colleagues to a corporate retreat, Sam (Nicholas D'Agosto) experiences a horrifying vision: the suspension bridge that they -- and many others -- are crossing starts to crumble around them. When his vision ends and, almost immediately, starts to come true, Sam takes quick action that saves a number of people, including his girlfriend, Molly (Emma Bell), and his best friend, Peter (Miles Fisher). However, the survivors soon find that Death will not be denied. (Horror, Thriller) - 2011

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

programme.title: Cleaner
programme.desc: Hoping to expose corruption, radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. Their cause soon gets hijacked by an extremist within their ranks who's ready to kill everyone. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

programme.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
programme.desc: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Children, Science fiction) - 1992

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

programme.title: The Town
programme.desc: Doug MacRay leads a band of ruthless bank robbers and has no real attachments except for James, who -- despite his dangerous temper -- is like a brother. Everything changes for Doug when James briefly takes a hostage, bank employee Claire Keesey. Learning that she lives in the gang's neighborhood, Doug seeks her out to discover what she knows, and he falls in love. As the romance deepens, he wants out of his criminal life, but that could threaten Claire. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2010

programme.title: Carrie
programme.desc: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror) - 1976

programme.title: The Apparition
programme.desc: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

programme.title: The Meg
programme.desc: Previously thought to be extinct, a massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific. With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 2018

programme.title: Meg 2: The Trench
programme.desc: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

programme.title: Red Riding Hood
programme.desc: Young Valerie (Amanda Seyfried) feels torn between two men. She loves Peter, but her parents intend that she marry wealthy Henry. Valerie and Peter are going to run away together, but her sister is killed by a werewolf before they can put their plan into action. The villagers call on the help of Father Solomon (Gary Oldman), a famous monster hunter who warns that the beast takes human form by day. Then Valerie suspects that the werewolf is someone she loves. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Romance) - 2011

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
programme.desc: While still a boy, Abraham Lincoln loses his mother to a vampire's bite. He vows revenge, but fails in the attempt, narrowly escaping with his life. He is rescued by Henry (Dominic Cooper), a charismatic vampire hunter who instructs Abe in the fine art of dispatching bloodsuckers. Abe (Benjamin Walker) continues his fight against the undead well into adulthood and his presidency, making a last stand against the ultimate vampire foe (Rufus Sewell) on the eve of the Civil War's defining battle. (Action, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy) - 2012

programme.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
programme.desc: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Based on the beloved Roald Dahl tale, this comedic and fantastical film follows young Charlie Bucket (Freddie Highmore) and his Grandpa Joe (David Kelly) as they join a small group of contest winners who get to tour the magical and mysterious factory of eccentric candy maker Willy Wonka (Johnny Depp). Aided by his diminutive Oompa Loompa workers (Deep Roy), Wonka has a hidden motivation for the tour, one that he will reveal only after the children in the group show their true colors. (Children, Fantasy, Comedy) - 2005

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
programme.desc: While still a boy, Abraham Lincoln loses his mother to a vampire's bite. He vows revenge, but fails in the attempt, narrowly escaping with his life. He is rescued by Henry (Dominic Cooper), a charismatic vampire hunter who instructs Abe in the fine art of dispatching bloodsuckers. Abe (Benjamin Walker) continues his fight against the undead well into adulthood and his presidency, making a last stand against the ultimate vampire foe (Rufus Sewell) on the eve of the Civil War's defining battle. (Action, Horror, Thriller, Fantasy) - 2012

programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other? (Animated, Science fiction) - 1973

programme.title: Walkabout
programme.desc: Under the pretense of having a picnic, a geologist (John Meillon) takes his teenage daughter (Jenny Agutter) and 6-year-old son (Lucien John) into the Australian outback and attempts to shoot them. When he fails, he turns the gun on himself, and the two city-bred children must contend with harsh wilderness alone. They are saved by a chance encounter with an Aboriginal boy (David Gulpilil) who shows them how to survive and in the process underscores the disharmony between nature and modern life. (Adventure) - 1971

programme.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
programme.desc: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

programme.title: Time Bandits
programme.desc: Young history buff Kevin (Craig Warnock) can scarcely believe it when six dwarfs emerge from his closet one night. Former employees of the Supreme Being (Ralph Richardson), they've purloined a map charting all the holes in the fabric of time and are using it to steal treasures from different historical eras. Taking Kevin with them, they variously drop in on Napoleon (Ian Holm), Robin Hood (John Cleese) and King Agamemnon (Sean Connery) before the Supreme Being catches up with them. (Fantasy) - 1981

programme.title: Hall Pass
programme.desc: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

programme.title: Adult Best Friends
programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

programme.title: Broken City
programme.desc: Former cop Billy Taggart (Mark Wahlberg) sees a chance at redemption for past sins when New York City's Mayor Nicolas Hostetler (Russell Crowe) calls on him for a special job. Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2013

programme.title: The Art of Getting By
programme.desc: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

programme.title: Collision Course
programme.desc: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy) - 1989

programme.title: The Player
programme.desc: Certain that the anonymous threats he's been receiving are the work of David Kahane (Vincent D'Onofrio), producer Griffin Mill (Tim Robbins) tries to fix things over cocktails. Instead, Griffin ends up murdering the screenwriter and courting the dead man's girlfriend (Greta Scacchi). As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood. (Comedy) - 1992

programme.title: Night on Earth
programme.desc: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

programme.title: The Man
programme.desc: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (Comedy) - 2012

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

programme.title: Contagion
programme.desc: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

programme.title: The Darkest Minds
programme.desc: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Frank Martin is living a less perilous lifestyle, or so he thinks, transporting classified packages for questionable people. Things get complicated when femme fatale Anna and her three accomplices orchestrate a bank heist and the kidnapping of Frank's father. It's all part of a grand plan to take down the human trafficker who victimized her years earlier. Now a pawn in her vengeful scheme, the former special-operations mercenary must use his covert skills to play Anna's dangerous game. (Action, Thriller) - 2015

But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him. (Children, Comedy drama) - 1998

programme.title: Air Bud: World Pup
programme.desc: The golden retriever helps his young owner (Kevin Zegers) and his coed soccer team to shine while outsmarting a wily dogcatcher. (Children, Comedy drama) - 2000

programme.title: Mission: Impossible III
programme.desc: Retired from active duty, and training recruits for the Impossible Mission Force, agent Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) faces the toughest foe of his career: Owen Davian (Philip Seymour Hoffman), an international broker of arms and information, who is as cunning as he is ruthless. Davian emerges to threaten Hunt and all that he holds dear -- including the woman Hunt loves. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2006

programme.title: Mission: Impossible Rogue Nation
programme.desc: With the IMF now disbanded and Ethan Hunt out in the cold, a new threat -- called the Syndicate -- soon emerges. The Syndicate is a network of highly skilled operatives who are dedicated to establishing a new world order via an escalating series of terrorist attacks. Faced with what may be the most impossible mission yet, Ethan gathers his team and joins forces with Ilsa Faust, a disavowed British agent who may or may not be a member of this deadly rogue nation. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2015

programme.title: Dark Side of the Cage - Conor vs Khabib ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: "Dark Side of the Cage" cuts through the glamour and glory of the MMA spectacle to reveal the never-before-told stories behind its most iconic fighters. (Documentary, Mixed martial arts) - 2026-09-29

programme.title: Mission: Impossible -- Fallout
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt and the IMF team join forces with CIA assassin August Walker to prevent a disaster of epic proportions. Arms dealer John Lark and a group of terrorists known as the Apostles plan to use three plutonium cores for a simultaneous nuclear attack on the Vatican, Jerusalem and Mecca, Saudi Arabia. When the weapons go missing, Ethan and his crew find themselves in a desperate race against time to prevent them from falling into the wrong hands. (Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2018

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Johnny Cage joins other fighters in the ultimate, no-holds-barred battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn, a powerful tyrant who threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders. (Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Fantasy) - 2026

programme.title: Is This Thing On?
programme.desc: Facing middle age and an impending divorce, Alex finds new purpose in the New York comedy scene, while his wife, Tess, confronts the sacrifices she made for their family. (Comedy drama) - 2025

programme.title: Blue Heron
programme.desc: A family of six settles into their new home on Vancouver Island as internal dynamics get revealed through the eyes of the youngest child. (Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Corner Gas - Comedy Night
programme.desc: Brent develops a grudge for an out-of-town comedian who performs at a comedy night in Dog River; Hank is star-struck by the guy and arranges to be the M.C. for the night. (Sitcom) - 2004-03-24

programme.title: Corner Gas - Hook, Line and Sinker
programme.desc: Brent puts a sign with slogans in front of the gas station and coffee shop; Brent and Emma worry about Oscar's memory. (Sitcom) - 2004-03-31

programme.title: Transplant - Home
programme.desc: Bash reconnects with the man who got him to Canada. (Medical, Drama) - 2023-10-20

programme.title: PAW Patrol: The Movie
programme.desc: When their biggest rival, Humdinger, starts wreaking havoc as the mayor of Adventure City, Ryder and everyone's favorite heroic pups kick into high gear to face the challenge. Armed with exciting new gadgets and gear, the PAW Patrol joins forces with a savvy dachshund to save the citizens of Adventure City. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2021

programme.title: PAW Patrol: The Mighty Movie
programme.desc: The PAW Patrol pups magically gain superpowers after a meteor strikes Adventure City. However, things take a turn for the worse when Humdinger and a mad scientist steal their powers and turn themselves into supervillains. As the team springs into action to save the city, Skye soon learns that even the smallest pup can make the biggest difference. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2023

programme.title: Selena + Chef - Selena + Aarti Sequeira: Friendsgiving
programme.desc: Known for elevating American dishes with Indian flavors, Aarti Sequeira whips up a tandoori butter turkey breast and colorful side dishes that might just revolutionize Selena's favorite holiday; they are joined by friends to celebrate the holiday. (Holiday, Cooking) - 2020-11-19

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries - An Inheritance to Die For
programme.desc: Sally's wealthy Aunt Gladys dies from poisoning after giving a wedding toast, prompting Aurora to inspect Gladys' will for clues as to who would have wanted her gone. (Mystery) - 2019-08-11

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries - A Very Foul Play
programme.desc: Aurora and friends are off to a resort for a true crime convention; while there, they take part in a mystery dinner theater, but art imitates life when a fellow actor gets killed. (Mystery) - 2019-08-18

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: Heist and Seek
programme.desc: When a priceless crown is stolen during a benefit gala, Aurora and the Real Murders Club must investigate who would kill to get their hands on it. (Mystery) - 2020

programme.title: Garage Sale Mysteries: Picture a Murder
programme.desc: Jenn gets the photos in an antique camera from the estate of a recently deceased and seemingly wealthy photography enthusiast printed, and one of the pictures leads her to believe that the man's death was anything but accidental. (Mystery, Crime drama) - 2018

programme.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
programme.desc: In the 1970s, young Gru tries to join a group of supervillains called the Vicious 6 after they oust their leader -- the legendary fighter Wild Knuckles. When the interview turns disastrous, Gru and his Minions go on the run with the Vicious 6 hot on their tails. Luckily, he finds an unlikely source for guidance -- Wild Knuckles himself -- and soon discovers that even bad guys need a little help from their friends. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2022

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: The true story of Mamie Till-Mobley's relentless pursuit of justice for her 14-year-old son, Emmett Till, who was brutally lynched in 1955 while visiting his cousins in Mississippi. (Drama) - 2022

programme.title: The Mother and the Bear
programme.desc: Sara is shocked to find her daughter has fallen into a temporary coma after a late-night slip on ice. Sara, travelling over 9000 kilometres, finds herself in the harsh, unfamiliar, and unforgiving environment of Winnipeg in the winter. (Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: In a fractured near-future America balanced on the razor's edge, a group of journalists must race through battlefields to reach the White House before D.C. falls. (Action, War, Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: The Furious
programme.desc: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo finds themselves in an explosive martial-arts showdown against a relentless gang of thugs. (Action, Martial arts) - 2025

programme.title: The Things You Kill
programme.desc: A university professor is unable to come to terms with the suspicious death of his mother. Things take a turn when coerces his gardener to kill people. (Mystery, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: Lucky Strikes
programme.desc: Two best friends compete in a national bowling championship to save their local lanes from the wrecking ball. (Comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Crossword Mysteries - Terminal Descent
programme.desc: When Tess prepares for a crossword challenge against a supercomputer, the engineer behind it gets murdered, spurring her and Logan to seek answers before they become the next victims. (Drama, Mystery) - 2021-02-14

programme.title: Pie to Die For: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
programme.desc: When Hannah's customer and Delores' theater rival is murdered, Hannah must find her killer in order to save her mother's reputation. Chad and Hannah's romance blossoms. (Mystery) - 2025

programme.title: Christmas With the Foxes
programme.desc: Rebecca Fox attends her family's annual Christmas party to find her dad is seeing a new woman, not even a year after her mother's death. In her comical efforts to derail the romance, she finds her own love affair. (Holiday, Comedy drama, Romance) - 2023

programme.title: We're All Gonna Die (Even Jay Baruchel) - Volcanic Cataclysm
programme.desc: Jay learns about a threat; supervolcanoes are often overlooked, but when they erupt they will change the Earth's climate. (Documentary, Entertainment, Dark comedy, Science) - 2022-05-09

programme.title: Diamonds Are Forever
programme.desc: While investigating mysterious activities in the world diamond market, 007 (Sean Connery) discovers that his evil nemesis Blofeld (Charles Gray) is stockpiling the gems to use in his deadly laser satellite. With the help of beautiful smuggler Tiffany Case (Jill St. John), Bond sets out to stop the madman -- as the fate of the world hangs in the balance! (Action) - 1971

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries - Reunited and It Feels So Deadly
programme.desc: Aurora's high school reunion turns deadly when a body is found in the hotel pool; Aurora and her Real Murders Club help investigate which classmate was most likely to kill. (Mystery) - 2020-10-18

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries - How to Con a Con
programme.desc: When Aida Teagarden's real estate client is found murdered, her sleuthing daughter, Aurora, sets out with her fiancé, Nick, and the Real Murders Club to solve the murder. (Mystery) - 2021-03-14

programme.title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries - Til Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Just days before Aurora's wedding, a body is discovered, and she fears her father may be a suspect; she and Nick race to solve the cold case before they walk down the aisle. (Mystery) - 2021-06-13

programme.title: The Amazing Maurice
programme.desc: Maurice is a streetwise ginger cat who comes up with a money-making scam by befriending a group of talking rats. However, when Maurice and the rodents reach the town of Bad Blintz, their little con soon goes down the drain. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

programme.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
programme.desc: Sonic, Knuckles and Tails reunite to battle Shadow, a mysterious new enemy with powers unlike anything they've faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, they seek out an unlikely alliance to stop Shadow and protect the planet. (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2024

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

programme.title: Just Friends
programme.desc: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart. (Romantic comedy) - 2005

programme.title: Patti Cake$
programme.desc: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back. (Drama, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2017

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth. (Musical, Biography, Historical drama) - 2017

programme.title: My Soul to Take
programme.desc: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

programme.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
programme.desc: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2018

programme.title: The Shape of Water
programme.desc: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

programme.title: The Lobster
programme.desc: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice. (Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2015

programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl
programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves. (Comedy, Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Trance
programme.desc: Simon (James McAvoy), a fine-art auctioneer, joins a gang of thieves led by Franck (Vincent Cassel) to steal a priceless Goya painting. During the heist Simon suffers a head injury and awakes with no memory of where he hid the artwork. When torture and physical threats fail to break through his amnesia, Franck hires a hypnotherapist named Elizabeth (Rosario Dawson) to find the answer. But as Elizabeth probes the recesses of Simon's mind, the lines between truth and deceit start to blur. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2013

programme.title: Aniara
programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

programme.title: The Whistlers
programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

programme.title: Body at Brighton Rock
programme.desc: Wendy, a part-time summer employee at a mountainous state park, takes on a rough trail assignment at the end of the season, trying to prove to her friends that she's capable enough to do the job. When she takes a wrong turn and ends up deep in the backcountry, she stumbles upon what might be a potential crime scene. Stuck with no communication after losing her radio and with orders to guard the site, Wendy must fight the urge to run. (Thriller) - 2019

programme.title: Hail Satan?
programme.desc: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul. (Documentary) - 2019

programme.title: The Possession
programme.desc: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host. (Horror, Thriller) - 2012

programme.title: The Apparition
programme.desc: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: After transferring to a Los Angeles high school, Sarah (Robin Tunney) finds that her telekinetic gift appeals to a group of three wannabe witches, who happen to be seeking a fourth member for their rituals. Bonnie (Neve Campbell), Rochelle (Rachel True) and Nancy (Fairuza Balk), like Sarah herself, all have troubled backgrounds, which combined with their nascent powers lead to dangerous consequences. When a minor spell causes a fellow student to lose her hair, the girls grow power-mad. (Horror) - 1996

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
programme.desc: Sue Ellen Crandell is a teenager eagerly awaiting her mother's summer-long absence. While the babysitter looks after her rambunctious younger siblings, Sue Ellen can party and have fun. But then the babysitter abruptly dies, leaving the Crandells short on cash. Sue Ellen finds a sweet job in fashion by lying about her age and experience on her résumé. But, while her siblings run wild, she discovers the downside of adulthood. (Comedy) - 1991

programme.title: Dim Sum Funeral
programme.desc: In the wake of her death, the embittered children of Chinese-American matriarch Mrs. Xiao (Lisa Lu) begrudgingly return to their childhood home for a bristly -- and brief, they hope -- reunion. But after Xiao's maid and sole confidant, Viola (Talia Shire), reveals her wish to undergo a week-long Buddhist funeral rite, the younger Xiaos -- including plastic surgeon Alexander (Russell Wong) and lesbian actress Meimei (Steph Song) -- have seven days to come to terms with her death, and each other. (Comedy drama) - 2008

programme.title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
programme.desc: Young Furiosa gets caught in the crossfire of two tyrannical warlords. As the tyrants fight for dominance, Furiosa soon finds herself in a nonstop battle to make her way home. (Action, Adventure) - 2024

programme.title: Final Destination 5
